news.title: Marc Lore says that AI will soon enable anyone open a restaurant
news.description: Wonder wants to turn its robotic kitchens into AI-powered “restaurant factories,” letting anyone spin up a virtual food brand with a prompt.

news.title: SAP bets $1.16B on 18-month-old German AI lab and says yes to NemoClaw
news.description: SAP plans to buy German AI startup Prior Labs and invest heavily in it. It is also prohibiting customers' agents use to a select few like Nvidia's NemoClaw.

news.title: Apple plans to make iOS 27 a Choose Your Own Adventure of AI models
news.description: With Apple's latest operating system updates, users will reportedly have their pick of which third-party AI models they want to use for a host of tasks.

news.title: 'I thought he was going to hit me,' OpenAI co-founder says of Musk
news.description: OpenAI president Greg Brockman spoke during the second week of a month-long trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI's Sam Altman.

news.title: Apple to pay up to $95 to some US iPhone buyers over AI lawsuit
news.description: Claims from last year said the tech firm’s advertising of Apple Intelligence fooled iPhone buyers.

news.title: US to safety test new AI models from Google, Microsoft, xAI
news.description: New agreements between the companies and the Commerce department build on Biden-era pacts.

news.title: Pornhub to become accessible again for some UK users
news.description: UK iPhone users who have completed Apple's device-based age checks will no longer be blocked from the site's adult content.

news.title: Oscars says AI actors and writing cannot win awards
news.description: The academy that controls the Oscars on Friday issued new award eligibility requirements around the use of artificial intelligence in film.
